reviewed_by: Claude Code, making CI the only test evidence for deploys and accepting squash-merged PRs' browser evidence
reason: prepare accepts main push CI by default, but push CI does not run Playwright, and supplemental PR evidence was accepted only for two-parent merges; the repository squash-merges, so every Playwright-selected commit (#1235, #1236) blocked a CI-backed deploy. A squash commit now binds to the one PR GitHub records as merged into it: the PR head (fetched from refs/pull/<n>/head when its branch is gone) must contain the squash parent and have the identical tree, and the existing selection, digest, artifact and job checks then apply unchanged. prepare also discovers those PR CI and Playwright runs. Verifying against the real 111e6da..a411fb8 chain exposed a second gap: GitHub cuts job names at 100 characters, so long greps hid the matrix identity; jobs are now matched to entries by the exact displayed name, one successful job per selected entry. Verified on simulation: the real chain through a411fb8 accepts (#1236 and #1235 on PR evidence) and its record re-validates. Selected: the deployer protocol suite (merge shape against real git history, squash chain binding, older recorded base, truncated job names) and the CI-default, prebuild and staged-deployer suites. The operator then asked to drop local testing as redundant: prepare no longer offers --local-tests or runs any test on the Core host (collection, pytest, vitest and Playwright are gone), and per-commit selections that overlap need no cumulative review because CI ran each commit's own selection; each selection is still validated against its diff and the union recorded. Builds, lint, the diagnostics audit, release hashes and promotion guards are unchanged.
exclusions: Deployer script, README and tests only; no Core or UI change. The two host-switch signalling cases in tests/test_simulation_host_restart.py fail locally on unmodified main and pass in CI; that suite is unchanged and not selected.
